explanation: The English article on the 1982 war places the invasion inside the civil war. By 1975 the Palestinian refugees in Lebanon numbered more than 300,000 and the PLO had in effect created a state within a state in the south, which then played a large part in the civil war. From 1976 Israel was already arming Lebanese Christian militias against the PLO, with the Maronite Phalange under Bashir Gemayel as its main partner. Israel had two war aims in June 1982, to destroy the PLO in Lebanon and to install a Maronite government under Gemayel. Only the civil war made those aims available. The article gives the attempted assassination of Shlomo Argov as the reason for going to war, and the civil war as what made an invasion of this shape possible. The type is therefore `enabled`.
